notes.title: Oculus Support + 2 New Challenges!
notes.content:
https://media.giphy.com/media/xTcf12gWvT0Gicp52U/giphy.gif

 Available Now for the Oculus 
You can now play Virtually Impossible on the Oculus. You will need the Oculus Touch controllers to play.

 Two New Impossible Challenges 
Ninja Vs Cannon
Test your ninja reflexes by parrying the cannon balls to avoid a gruesome death.

Eating Champion
Finally, the moment you've been waiting for. Show off your eating skills by eating all the hot dogs before the time runs out.

Look out for more challenges and features coming soon!
